shape._note: Set before the first milestone (PRO-79): Atomico enters mostly at Series A and later with a growth sleeve and a concentrated book of famous names (Stripe, Klarna, Supercell, Graphcore, PsiQuantum, StarkWare ...), so the $1B+ share on a ~180-row book can exceed the 20% megafund default; restated to 30% with the guard still firing above it. S2A ceiling kept at the 80% default.

site_api._note: atomico.com is a Next.js site over the Hygraph CMS behind a Vercel bot checkpoint (a direct fetch returns the 429 checkpoint page), so the site layer is read from the Internet Archive's captures of the firm's own pages (escalation ladder step 3, __NEXT_DATA__): scratch/cms-pull.py -> cms-partners.json (every /partners/<slug> page 2021-2026, newest capture: investment year, lead, Venture/Growth, Current/Exited, location, themes). careers.atomico.com is a Getro job board (Thrive/Cherry precedent), live-readable. entry_stage_fields stays empty until the Venture/Growth field is scored against documented rounds (decisions.md D10).
site_api.entry_stage_fields_basis: The CMS 'Stage' field is the sleeve that made the partnership (Venture or Growth). Scored 2026-09-26 against the book's own cited entry rounds: 'Growth' 25/26 (the miss is Bird, a Series A under a Growth label), below the 30-row bar, so medium; 'Venture' 52/61 and straddles Seed, Series A and Series B-C entries, so it is an anchor that mints no stage (stage_words.py).
